SHARED-F-2-S124.title: Consent Data Schema & Storage Contract
SHARED-F-2-S124.description: Define and implement MongoDB schema and storage contracts for consent records, including tier levels, timestamps, user/session linkage, and audit trail fields required for HIPAA compliance and traceability.

SHARED-F-2-S125.title: Consent Enforcement Middleware Layer
SHARED-F-2-S125.description: Implement a reusable enforcement layer that intercepts all data persistence calls and validates consent tier before allowing storage, including fallback to de-identification when Tier 2 consent is not granted.

SHARED-F-2-S126.title: Consent Audit Logging & Traceability
SHARED-F-2-S126.description: Implement detailed audit logging for all consent decisions, including consent capture, tier transitions, enforcement actions, and data storage outcomes to support compliance review and debugging.

SHARED-F-2-S127.title: Consent Framework Unit & Integration Tests
SHARED-F-2-S127.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests covering consent tier logic, enforcement behavior, de-identification fallback, and cross-service interactions to ensure correctness and prevent regression.
